name: Texture segmentation benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating algorithms on texture segmentation, i.e., partitioning images into regions of homogeneous texture.
evaluation_method: IoU (Intersection over Union) / pixel accuracy (and boundary/region F1 in some evaluations)
reputation: A classical, task-specific benchmark cited in texture segmentation literature but not a broadly used modern standard in deep learning medical imaging communities.
notes: Non-LLM, classical computer-vision benchmark; relatively small and older dataset by modern standards and may be outpaced by larger contemporary segmentation datasets and deep-learning evaluation protocols.
